title: CommanDeck
description: CommandDeck is a lightweight Fabric client mod that adds a configurable in-game command deck for running commands, keybinds, chat messages, and multi-step action chains. Inspired by QuickMenu and rebuilt for modern Minecraft.
body:
# CommanDeck

CommanDeck is a lightweight client-side action deck for Minecraft. It lets you open a small in-game menu and create buttons that can run commands, send chat messages, trigger existing keybinds, open folders, and run simple multi-step action chains.

It is useful for players who often repeat the same commands or actions, especially on servers, creative worlds, admin setups, testing worlds, or modpacks.

## Features

- Create custom action buttons
- Run Minecraft commands
- Send chat messages
- Trigger existing Minecraft keybinds
- Chain multiple actions together
- Add delays between actions
- Add simple conditions, such as only running while sneaking
- Play a small sound as feedback
- Open URLs or Minecraft screens
- Organize buttons into folders
- Use item icons, including CustomModelData icons
- Search through actions and folders
- Configure grid size and menu behavior

## Dependencies

None

Required:
- Fabric Loader or NeoForge

Optional:
- Mod Menu, for easier config access on Fabric

## Loader support

CommanDeck currently supports Fabric and experimental NeoForge.

Quilt is not currently targeted because it does not support this Minecraft version yet, but the project should be able to support it later if Quilt catches up.

## Inspiration

CommanDeck is inspired by the older QuickMenu projects:

- [ImCodist/quick-menu](https://github.com/ImCodist/quick-menu)
- [tenkun0317/quick-menu](https://github.com/tenkun0317/quick-menu)

CommanDeck was rebuilt for newer Minecraft versions with fewer required dependencies.
